_comment: Settings > Plots, native emtk window bound to PlotSettingsModel (gui/model.py). 'settings' is the scrolling column of controls, 'preview' the live sample plot beside it (drawn by gui/app.py: a plot is not something a spec can express). Every change applies at once and is saved to gui.plot, as in Settings > Fonts.
title: Plot Settings

sections.name: settings
sections.title: Settings
sections.description: Every plot setting. A change applies at once and is kept for the next start.

sections.title: Curves
sections.description: Colour and width of the curves of a fit plot. The preview shows each one.

sections.label: Data
sections.description: Colour of the measured data. Click the swatch for a colour picker, or type a hex value such as #ffa629.

sections.label: Model
sections.description: Colour of the fitted model curve, drawn over the data in the fit range.

sections.label: IRF
sections.description: Colour of the instrument response function (IRF).

sections.label: Residuals
sections.description: Colour of the weighted residuals, (data − model) / σ, in the strip above the data.

sections.label: Autocorrelation
sections.description: Colour of the autocorrelation of the residuals, the top strip: flat for a good fit, a wave for a systematic misfit.

sections.label: Line width
sections.description: Width of the model, IRF, residual and autocorrelation curves. The noisy data trace is drawn at half of it, so the model stays visible through it.

sections.title: Fit range
sections.description: The draggable band that marks the channels the fit uses.

sections.label: Show fit-range band
sections.description: Draw the draggable fit-range band on the data panel. Off, the range is still used; it is set in the fit's own controls.

sections.label: Colour
sections.description: Colour of the fit-range band.

sections.label: Opacity
sections.description: Opacity of the fit-range band, 0 (invisible) to 255 (solid). Much above 60 it reads as a fill and hides the data under it.

sections.title: Global fits
sections.description: How the datasets of a global fit are told apart when they are shown together.

sections.label: Selected fit
sections.description: Opacity of the curves of the selected dataset, 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid).

sections.label: Other fits
sections.description: Opacity of the curves of the other datasets of the group, 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid). The preview shows a second dataset at this opacity.

sections.title: Axes and grid
sections.description: Axis names, legend, axis text size and the grid of each panel.

sections.label: Axis text
sections.description: Point size of the tick numbers, axis names and legend. 'auto' (0) follows the interface font of Settings ▸ Fonts. Open plots follow at once.

sections.label: Grid strength
sections.description: How strongly the grid is drawn: 0 % none, 30 % the theme's own grid, 100 % solid lines.

sections.title: Show
sections.description: Which plot furniture new fit plots show.

sections.label: Axis names
sections.description: Show the axis names (counts, time, w.res., a.corr.). Off gives the space to the data in a narrow panel.

sections.label: Legend
sections.description: Show the legend naming each curve on the data panel of new plots.

sections.label: Grid
sections.description: Draw grid lines. Off turns the grid off on every panel; on, the three switches below pick the panels.

sections.label: Grid on data
sections.description: Draw the grid on the data panel.

sections.label: Grid on residuals
sections.description: Draw the grid on the weighted-residuals strip.

sections.label: Grid on autocorrelation
sections.description: Draw the grid on the autocorrelation strip.

sections.title: Node graphs
sections.description: Background grid and node size of the node graphs: Global View, the light path, the provenance inspector and the node editor.

sections.label: Show grid
sections.description: Show the background grid of a node graph.

sections.label: Grid line width
sections.description: Grid line thickness. Below one pixel draws a hairline; on a HiDPI screen a full pixel doubles to two device pixels and the grid starts to out-weigh the edges drawn on top of it.

sections.label: Grid opacity
sections.description: Grid line opacity of a node graph, per cent.

sections.label: Grid spacing
sections.description: Distance between the grid lines of a node graph, 4 to 96 pixels.

sections.label: Node size
sections.description: The node radius a newly opened Global View starts its own node-size control at. A window that is already open keeps the value its slider holds.

buttons.label: Reset to defaults
buttons.description: Every plot setting back to the shipped look, applied at once and saved.

sections.description: What the last change did.

sections.name: preview
sections.title: Preview
sections.description: A simulated measurement drawn with the settings: follows every change.

A simulated TCSPC measurement (instrument response convolved with two lifetimes, background, Poisson noise) and a fit that is close but not exact, with its weighted residuals and their autocorrelation, and a second dataset of a global fit. Not your data.
